# What motion blocks do
Motion blocks are blue. They drive the robot's two motors.

# move forward for seconds
Drives both wheels forward for the number of seconds you type. Use move backward for the opposite direction. Without a time, the block move forward keeps going until another block changes it.

# turn right degrees and turn left degrees
Turns the robot on the spot by the number of degrees. A quarter turn is 90 degrees and a half turn is 180. Turn accuracy depends on the floor and on the wheels being tight.

# set speed to percent
Sets how fast the motors run from 0 to 100 percent. Slower speeds give straighter lines and sharper turns. The default speed is 60 percent.

# stop all motors
Stops both motors immediately. Use it inside an if block to stop before a wall.
